costs.copy_only: dead bank copy is a strict subset of all-free post-to-head; do not extrapolate 5GiB capacity into latency
costs.qualification: Original request/clock/external schedule sensitivity; not a universal upper bound or expected speedup. 1% is ranking reference, not user accuracy/performance acceptance.
costs.same_budget_small_variants: 已停止: independent 1% latency budget for terminal Post->head input and separate target head/verify. Larger last-layer, next-input/host scheduling and capacity budgets are distinct.

verification.greedy: K1 specialized and variable K kernels inspected; first mismatch emits target argmax then stops, all match appends bonus; prefilled -1 suffix retained; K0 appends bonus in general kernel
verification.random: inspected ordinary per-token kernel and recovered vocab loop; preserve p/q FP32, uniform/exponential generator mapping and chunk tie order; block verifier and complete RNG/processor producer paths remain open
verification.fusion: Can co-produce accepted prefix count/last seed and output packet after reject decision. A single independent CTA/request can avoid count rescan, but cannot read other CTAs before join; output D2H/CPU stop/next-context consumers still distinct.

asynchronous.already_overlapped: sampled IDs and optional logprobs/NaNs copied on independent stream after wait_stream; event protects device tensor lifetime and CPU parse; DSpark consumes GPU IDs without this CPU copy
asynchronous.histories: CPU -1 optimistic placeholders repaired by previous req-ID mapping and copy event only when logits processors need history; not real accepted token IDs
asynchronous.scheduler: async reserves bonus+draft placeholders, subtracts rejected tokens before output append/stop trim; stale/preempted output must not roll back current generation counters
asynchronous.mamba: need_accepted_tokens only hybrid cache; do not charge inactive hybrid state-update kernel to this target
asynchronous.actual_correction: NPU V1 imports vllm_ascend.spec_decode.utils (not upstream helper). It snapshots three advanced gathers before any in-place output: for old draft rows corrected=old_gpu_computed+valid_count; new/no-draft uses current CPU count. previous positions map current req ID to previous row.
asynchronous.input_ids: Inherited _prepare_input_ids scatters previous bonus at cu_num_tokens-1-current_draft_len and scheduled prefix of previous draft rows using previous K stride; new/prefill gets CPU source. Stable no-spec contiguous map already has direct slice fast path.
asynchronous.CPU_metadata: same rejection drift prev_drafts+1-valid_count subtracted from optimistic CPU seq_len only for participating old draft rows, after existing previous-step count-copy event; then slot mapping uses corrected GPU positions.
asynchronous.engine: FIFO result drain follows attempted queue filling; pending structured output defers sample until prior output, abort queue processed before scheduler update. Eliminating CPU output copy does not remove client/stop/grammar/history readers.
asynchronous.worker_bridge: Multiproc WorkerProc queues AsyncModelRunnerOutput to separate output thread; enqueue_output calls get_output/event sync, catches exceptions and publishes failure; Ascend executor patch does not override these output methods.
asynchronous.client: OutputProcessor runs detokenizer then logprob update and output formatting; final-only/stream_interval can suppress publication. Stop strings choose earliest completion (ties by stop-list order), retain holdback suffix for delta output; frontend-detected stop sends abort to core. CPU IDs may still include an accepted suffix that scheduler stopped/trimmed; preserve original counters and queue semantics.
asynchronous.retirement: Scheduler _free_request invokes KV/EC request_finished before freeing encoder state; connector delay/receive-inflight or defer_block_free can retain blocks. finished_sending/recving later retires only correct request. KV runner finalize happens after DSpark forward, wait_for_save then clear metadata; zeroing/reuse cannot race async transfer.
asynchronous.packet_candidate: reject may co-emit accepted count and last seed; next input row mapping unknown until next scheduler result, so direct writing future input positions needs stable request-slot/generation plan. In-place permutation correction must preserve snapshot before writes (cannot fuse load/store naively across CTAs).
